title: Phase 5 Assets Manifest Artifact
description: Schema for the assets_manifest.jsonl, which lists all binary assets required by the UI.

asset_type.description: The type of asset: 'ui' for application chrome, 'corpus' for content-specific media.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the asset file (legacy manifests may contain a path relative to the Library root).

sha256.description: The SHA256 content hash of the asset file.

asset_id.description: The unique identifier for the asset (only for 'corpus' type).
